summary: CICS online Add Transaction screen. The user enters an account/card and transaction details (type, category, amount, dates, merchant, description); the program validates the key and data fields, derives the next transaction id from the last transaction, and writes a new transaction record. Can copy the last transaction's data as a template. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the add-transaction screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; PF4 copy last transaction as a template; Enter process the add. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the key fields, then the data fields; if all valid, add the transaction.
branches: IF key valid AND data valid -> add

paragraphs.name: VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account id and card number: present, numeric, correct length; verify the card/account exists via the cross-reference.
branches: IF card not found in xref -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account/card must be present, valid, and exist in the cross-reference before a transaction can be added.

paragraphs.name: VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the transaction data: type code and category code present/valid, amount a valid signed amount, origin and processing dates valid, merchant id numeric, and required descriptive fields present.
branches: IF amount not valid signed -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: transaction type/category, a valid signed amount, valid dates, and merchant id are required to add a transaction.

paragraphs.name: ADD-TRANSACTION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Derive the next transaction id from the latest transaction (browse backward), build the transaction record from the entered fields with a current timestamp, and write it to the transaction file.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a new transaction id is generated by incrementing the most recent transaction id.

paragraphs.name: COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pre-fill the screen with the last transaction's field values as a template for the new entry.

paragraphs.name: READ-CXACAIX-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card cross-reference by account (alternate index) to confirm the account and get the card.

paragraphs.name: READ-CCXREF-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card cross-reference by card number to confirm the card exists.

paragraphs.name: STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Start a browse of the transaction file to locate the latest transaction id.

paragraphs.name: READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the previous (latest) transaction to derive the next id / template values.

paragraphs.name: WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the new transaction record to the transaction file; on error report it.

paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and send the add-transaction map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNADD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the add-transaction map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, ids).

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the previous menu/screen.

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize all map fields to defaults.
